comments.author: chidev
comments.text:
Tracker policy lock: Beads-only tracking for component unification (no txt/csv sidecars).

Execution state model per component task:
- migrated
- agent_visual_qa
- human_qa
- swapped

Gate model:
- Use existing P3 protocol comment on each child (G1..G12) as source of truth.
- Do not mark swapped=pass until migrated + agent_visual_qa + human_qa are pass and G9..G12 evidence is attached in task comments.

Batch workflow:
1) Select next ready child tasks under ap-4rs
2) Run agent visual QA and attach evidence
3) Run human QA and attach decision
4) Rewrite imports and run runtime smoke
5) Close task only after swapped=pass evidence
